releases.name: 3.0.0: one entry point, one reference
releases.notes:
## Install

Minimal package: `opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.0-min.zip` contains only what the skill runs — `SKILL.md`, `references/` (one doc plus two dated seeds), `scripts/` (one entry point + modules) and `LICENSE`. Unzip it into `~/.config/opencode/skills/` so the folder is named `opencode-go-model-picker`. Verify with `node scripts/go.mjs --help` (four verbs: `run` / `report` / `check` / `apply`).

Full notes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · 中文：[CHANGELOG-ZH.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md)

## [3.0.0] - 2026-11-01

### The size of the simplification

3.0.0 is not a feature release: it is the same job described with **an order of
magnitude less text**. Measured against the 2.0.0 tag:

| What the model must read | 2.0.0 | 3.0.0 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Markdown files | 7 (`SKILL.md` + 6 references) | 2 (`SKILL.md` + `plan-facts.md`) | −5 files |
| Characters | 104,181 | 8,291 | **12.6× smaller** (−92%) |
| Lines | 1,776 | 168 | **10.6× fewer** (−91%) |
| Estimated tokens | ≈27,400 | ≈2,200 | **≈25,200 saved per full read** |
| `SKILL.md` alone | 18,804 chars ≈4,900 tok | 4,221 chars ≈1,100 tok | −78% |
| Runnable entry points | 9 runtime scripts (11 with maintainer tools) | 1 (`go.mjs`) | −8 runtime |
| Minimal install zip | 128,802 B | 89,163 B | −3…

releases.name: v1.2.0
releases.notes:
# v1.2.0

`skill_management` gives every installed OpenCode skill a switch: list what is installed, find out
why one will not load, hide it from the model, and put it back. Disabling writes **one** global
`skill` permission rule — no skill file is ever moved, edited or deleted.

**No breaking changes in 1.2.0.** The four actions, their inputs, the JSON envelope, the written
rule shape, the same-line marker and the single-file layout are unchanged since 1.1.0.

## Fixed since v1.1.0

- **`list` no longer reports "N skills differ across other agents" on every call.**
 `summary.diverged` counted hidden internal agents (`title`, `summary`, …), which carry
 `{*,*,deny}`; on a real machine that made every skill look divergent (33/33) and added a noise
 warning to each `list`. Only **visible** agents are compared now; `inspect.agents[]` still lists
 every agent, so the detail is not lost.
- **Frontmatter booleans no longer contradict each other.** `disable-model-invocation: "false"` is a
 string, and `Boolean("false") === true`, so `inspect` reported it as `true` while `list` reported
 `autoinvoke: false` for the same file. `true/yes/on/1` and `false/no/off/0` (quoted or not) are
 normalized now, and both fields go through the same rule.
- **A failed sidecar write no longer turns a successful config change into an error.** Once the
 config was written and verified, a sidecar write fa…

en.headline: 27 commits across 5 repositories, plus 15 automated commits
en.summary: **27 commits** were recorded across 5 repositories, alongside 15 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 16 own commits prepared `v1.2.0` and `v1.2.1`, fixed concurrent write serialization, narrowed `config_unparsable` rejection to the target config file, and reorganized the README and site docs. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker`, 6 own commits consolidated the tool into one entry point with four verbs, corrected release measurements, and documented the measured minimal-zip size. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 2 own commits added minimal verification steps and clarified the roles and source checks of three review commands. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, 2 own commits corrected the G2 status and documented the Google 2 key path in the settings card. The remaining commit in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` added a daily-report workflow gate that validates generated artifacts. No pull requests, issues, reviews, or discussions were recorded.

releaseNotes.summary: The release packages only the skill runtime: `SKILL.md`, one reference document with two dated seeds, scripts, and `LICENSE`. It provides a single entry point with four verbs, `run`, `report`, `check`, and `apply`, and documents the measured size reduction.

This release keeps the four actions, JSON envelope, permission-rule shape, and single-file layout unchanged from `v1.1.0`. It fixes `list` so hidden internal agents no longer make every skill appear divergent, and disabling a skill writes one global `skill` permission rule without moving, editing, or deleting skill files.

zh.headline: 5 个仓库共 27 次提交，另有 15 次自动提交
zh.summary: **27 次提交**分布在 5 个仓库，另有 15 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 16 次本人提交完成了 `v1.2.0` 与 `v1.2.1` 的准备，修复并发写入序列化问题，将 `config_unparsable` 的拒绝范围收窄到目标配置文件，并重组 README 与文档站内容。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 的 6 次本人提交将工具整合为带四个动词的单一入口，修正发布测量数据，并记录实测的最小压缩包体积。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 2 次本人提交补充了最小验证步骤，并说明三种审查命令的分工与来源核对方式。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 的 2 次本人提交更正了 G2 状态，并在设置卡片中说明 Google 2 密钥路径。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的另 1 次提交为日报工作流增加了校验生成物的门禁。当天没有 pull request、issue、review 或讨论记录。

releaseNotes.summary: 该版本仅打包技能运行所需内容：`SKILL.md`、一份参考文档及两个带日期的种子文件、脚本和 `LICENSE`。它提供单一入口和 `run`、`report`、`check`、`apply` 四个动词，并记录了实测的体积缩减。
该版本相对 `v1.1.0` 保持四个动作、JSON 信封、权限规则格式和单文件布局不变。它修复了 `list` 将隐藏内部代理误判为技能分歧的问题；禁用技能时只写入一条全局 `skill` 权限规则，不移动、编辑或删除技能文件。
